About HILO

Play’n GO has gone live with Lawn n’ Complete Disorder, a 243-ways video slot whose defining feature is structural rather than thematic. The studio has routed its entire feature set through a single Coin symbol.

The design decision matters more than the garden-war premise. Coins can award an Instant Bonus, open Hold & Spin, or launch one of the wheel-driven Bonus Spins modes. That gives the whole feature set one consistent trigger.

That consolidation is the news hook. Rather than spreading activation across scatters, dedicated bonus symbols, and separate triggers, Play’n GO has made one symbol responsible for every route into a feature.
